title: Abd al-Rahman the Maghribi's Story of the Rukh
logline: A traveller tells how his crew broke open a giant egg on an unknown island, were chased across the sea by the Roc with a boulder in its claws, escaped by a hair, and how he brought home a feather with a quill wide enough to hold a waterskin.
moral: A tale of wonder, enjoyed as a legend and not as natural history; and inside the tale, careless men who take what is not theirs bring danger on themselves.
tone: A tall tale told with a straight face: wonder and real suspense at sea, comic relief in the crew's reactions and the black beards, a warm wink at the end.

beats.summary: Abd al-Rahman the Maghribi begins a marvelous sea tale to two listeners; a closed curtain behind him hides something tall (the payoff of P7).
The ship stops at an unknown island for water and wood; a few men wander inland.
They find a huge white dome and do not know what it is.
They strike it until it cracks.
It is an egg: the egg of the legendary Roc.
Inside lies a gigantic chick; the men take meat and feathers to the ship.
They never think of the parent: a vast shadow slides over the broken egg after they leave.
At sea an immense bird appears and its wings dim the light.
It carries a great rock in its claws and comes straight for them; they understand why.
Captain and crew are afraid and drive the ship as fast as it will go.
The Roc arrives overhead and drops the rock.
The ship has moved just far enough: the stone crashes into the sea behind the stern.
They are saved and talk of the size of the bird and the speed of their escape.
The fantastic claim: old men who ate the chick meat saw their white beards turn black.
The curtain opens: he kept a giant feather.
Its hollow quill is wide enough to hold a goatskin water vessel.
He carried the feather home as proof of his tale.
The Roc is a legend of marvels, not a scientific account of a real bird.

scenes.summary: The frame: Abd al-Rahman, seated on a cushion in a merchant room, begins his sea tale to a doubtful merchant and an eager boy. A drawn curtain behind him hides something very tall (its top makes the curtain rail bulge). A thought cloud opens over him with a tiny ship; the camera dives into it.

scenes.composition: Bird centred (500, 420), s 4 growing to 5.5; rock hangs at about (500, 640). Crew heads along y 980..1100 at the bottom edge of the picture area, all gazes converge on the bird. Close shot: Abd centre, elder1 left, sailorA right, thought cloud above at (500, 300).

scenes.summary: Panic and speed: the captain shakes, then drives the crew; sail hauled tight, oars out, one sailor even blows into the sail. The Roc arrives directly overhead and opens its claws.

camera.notes: 88.1 medium on the captain at the bow (zoom 1.6). 91.0 pull to the whole deck (zoom 1.2) with speed lines. 94.8 wide (zoom 1.0, sky two thirds) as the bird arrives above. 96.9 quick push to the talons for the release.

The stern clears the ring by a hand; the stone hits the sea with a great column of water and the ship is lifted and soaked but whole.

So the teller gets up, walks to the curtain and pulls it: a feather taller than the room.

scenes.summary: How it got here: the traveller rides a camel along the desert road toward his home city, the giant feather lashed along the saddle and sticking out far behind, bobbing. At the gate he lifts his hand to it: proof.

A last cloud replays the legend in small (island with the egg, the bird dropping its rock by the tiny ship) and then dissolves into sparkles: a tale of wonder. A real sparrow lands on the window sill, measures itself against the giant feather, and shrugs. The teller winks. THE END.

subtitles.ar: روى عبد الرحمن المغربي حكاية عجيبة|عن رحلة بحرية في بلاد بعيدة قرب الصين.|قال إن سفينته توقفت عند جزيرة ليحصل البحارة على الماء والحطب،|فنزل بعضهم يتجولون بين الصخور والأشجار.
subtitles.en: Abd al-Rahman the Maghribi|told a marvelous sea story from waters near China.|His ship stopped at an island|to collect water and wood.

subtitles.ar: وجد الرجال شيئًا أبيض هائلًا يشبه قبة مستديرة،|ولم يعرفوا ما هو. اقتربوا منه وضربوه حتى تشقق،|فاكتشفوا أنه بيضة لطائر عظيم|يسمونه الرخ في الحكايات القديمة.
subtitles.en: The sailors found an enormous white dome.|They struck it until it cracked|and discovered, according to the legend,|that it was an egg of the giant bird called the Roc.

subtitles.ar: كان داخل البيضة فرخ ضخم،|فأخذ الرجال من لحمه وريشه، وحملوا ما استطاعوا إلى السفينة.|لم يدركوا أن فعلتهم قد تجلب خطرًا كبيرًا|إذا عاد الطائر الأب أو الأم إلى المكان.
subtitles.en: Inside lay a gigantic chick.|The men took some meat and feathers back to the ship,|without considering what might happen|when the parent returned.

subtitles.ar: أبحرت السفينة،|ثم ظهر في السماء طائر هائل يحجب بجناحيه جزءًا من الضوء.|رآه البحارة يحمل صخرة عظيمة بمخالبه،|ويتجه نحوهم، فأدركوا أنه يطاردهم بسبب البيضة المكسورة.
subtitles.en: After they sailed,|an immense bird appeared overhead,|carrying a huge rock in its claws.|The crew realized it was pursuing them because of the broken egg.

subtitles.ar: خاف الربان والبحارة، وزادوا سرعة السفينة ما استطاعوا.|وصل الطائر فوقهم وأسقط الصخرة،|لكن السفينة كانت قد تقدمت في اللحظة المناسبة،|فسقط الحجر في البحر ولم يصبها.
subtitles.en: The captain urged the ship onward.|The bird dropped its rock,|but the vessel had moved just far enough|for the stone to crash into the sea.

subtitles.ar: نجا الركاب وعادوا يتحدثون عن عظمة الطائر وسرعة نجاتهم.|ويضيف الراوي أن بعض الرجال المسنين أكلوا من لحم الفرخ،|فتحولت لحاهم البيضاء إلى اللون الأسود بطريقة خارقة.
subtitles.en: The passengers survived and marveled at their escape.|The narrator adds the fantastic claim that eating the chick’s meat|turned elderly men’s white beards black.

subtitles.ar: ويقول عبد الرحمن إن أولئك الرجال لم تشب لحاهم بعد ذلك،|وإنه احتفظ بريشة عظيمة من الطائر.|وكانت قصبة الريشة واسعة إلى حد|أنه استطاع أن يضع فيها وعاء من جلد الماعز.
subtitles.en: Abd al-Rahman further claimed|their beards never went gray again.|He kept a feather whose hollow shaft|was said to hold a goatskin water vessel.

subtitles.ar: حمل المسافر الريشة معه إلى بلاده شاهدًا على ما رواه.|هكذا تنتهي أسطورة الرخ،|بين جزيرة مجهولة وطائر يرمي الصخور،|وهي حكاية خيال وعجائب لا وصف علمي لطائر حقيقي.
subtitles.en: He brought the feather home as proof of his tale.|The Roc story|is a legend of marvels,|not a scientific account of an actual bird.

new_assets.name: islandShore
new_assets.description: Island beach strip with sea, ship berth, spring, rocks, palms and a clearing (see sets).
new_assets.implementation: One function in the towns.js style returning anchors {ground, berth, plank, spring, rocks, palms, clearing}. bake() the static layers per option set; sea bands reuse the openSea wave drawing; palms are palmTree; rocks are K polygons with dot fills; front pass redraws rocks and trunks over the cast. Reusable for any shipwreck, Sindbad or castaway story.

new_assets.name: openSea
new_assets.description: Looping open sea with parallax wave layers, horizon island and a shadow overlay (see sets).
new_assets.implementation: Sky via skyCycle; each wave layer is a filled path of repeated arcs offset by (scroll * speed) mod pitch, so every frame is a pure function of t; front layer drawn after the ship; shadow drawn with globalAlpha 0.35 navy using a bird silhouette path. Reusable for every sea voyage.

new_assets.name: dhow
new_assets.description: Sailing ship with deck line, lateen sail billow, oars, pitch and gangplank (see props).
new_assets.implementation: Hull as a closed bezier with plank lines, back pass (far rail, mast, sail) and front pass (near rail); sail is a triangle whose free edge control point moves with billow; oars are lines rotating about rail pivots from a phase; crew are Library person figures placed on the returned deck anchors. Share with the harbourQuay dhow (AN-146).

new_assets.name: rocEgg
new_assets.description: Half-buried giant egg with crack, hole, fallen slab and an inside callback (see props).
new_assets.implementation: Half ellipse path; crack as a seeded polyline revealed by length (crack 0..1); hole as a seeded polygon filled navy then inside(ctx) clipped; front pass re-strokes the hole rim. Reusable as any giant egg, dome or white boulder.

new_assets.name: giantFeather
new_assets.description: Huge feather with a hollow quill end, sway, curl and a cutaway window (see props).
new_assets.implementation: Vane as two beziers about a shaft with notch splits; calamus as a tapered tube with an ellipse mouth; cut draws an oval window and clips inside(ctx). Same function as the planned featherFall single feather with a size and quill option.

new_assets.name: boulder (with axe, woodBundle)
new_assets.description: Small flat props: the grey rock carried by the Roc, a wood axe, a stick bundle.
new_assets.implementation: Seeded polygons and lines with K brush outlines; the boulder is passed to bird carry as a function.

new_assets.name: chick
new_assets.description: The planned standalone chick (KD-016) drawn very large and asleep for the cross-section.
new_assets.implementation: Reuse the planned function at s about 9 with lid 1; if it is not built yet, a yellow ellipse body 150 x 120, head r 50, tuft of 3 strokes, small orange beak, closed eye arc.

new_assets.name: groundShadow
new_assets.description: Planned moving shadow of a flying bird, here very large: over the egg (61.06) and over sea and ship (71.5), plus the round rock shadow on the deck (96.16).
new_assets.implementation: Draw bird({kind:'hawk', silhouette:true, fly:true}) flattened (scale y 0.35) in navy at alpha 0.35 after the set and cast, clipped to the panel; the rock shadow is an ellipse.

new_assets.name: splash
new_assets.description: Planned crown of drops with rings, with a large column mode for the rock (104.72): column 150 wide, 700 high.
new_assets.implementation: White column polygon with blue dot shading that rises (5 frames), hangs and collapses; 14 seeded drops on parabolas; 3 expanding ripple rings; all from t - t0.

new_assets.name: beard colour wipe
new_assets.description: A beard that changes colour from the roots to the tip while the aged face and stoop stay.
new_assets.implementation: Draw the person twice: once with pal.beard white, once with pal.beard black clipped to the region above a horizontal line that moves down from the chin to the beard tip over 2.5 s. Fallback: pal.beard = mixHex(white, black, p). Check that pal.beard overrides the age colour.

new_assets.name: waterskin, carryBasket (cloth cover), foodTray (cover), floorCushion, portraitMedallion
new_assets.description: Small props already planned by other films, reused under their planned names.
new_assets.implementation: As planned; the only additions are a cloth cover on the basket and the tray.

new_assets.name: legendFrame, windStreaks, iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned small effects reused: the legend card look (38.5, 166.7), wind over the clearing (58.44), one bird-silhouette balloon (112.24).
new_assets.implementation: As planned by AN-088, KD-016 and others.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English translation is an abridgement of the Arabic in every paragraph (for example P1 omits the men wandering among rocks and trees, P2 omits 'they did not know what it was', P4 omits the wings blocking the light, P5 omits the fear of captain and crew, P8 omits 'between an unknown island and a bird that throws rocks'); both are kept verbatim.

Softened: the taking of meat from the chick is never shown; the chick appears once, asleep-looking, in a cross-section (44.9-48.5), then the shell hides everything and the men come out with a covered basket and feathers (default: keep it discreet).

Added frame: the tale is told by Abd al-Rahman in a merchant room to two invented listeners, a doubting merchant and an eager boy, who react at the start, at the feather and at the end (default: keep).

Added gags not in the script: a sailor blowing into the sail (93.3), a young sailor sneaking a bite to darken his moustache (127.1), a dove bounced off the feather (151.8) and a real sparrow comparing itself with the giant feather under the last line (169.2-172.5) (default: keep all four).
The legend card at 41.7 shows a tiny elephant in the Roc talons for scale, a traditional detail of the legend that this script does not mention (default: keep for one second).
P8 says he carried the feather home; it is staged as a short camel ride to a desert city gate, an invented picture of his homeland (default: keep; alternative: a ship arriving at a harbour).

Invented lettering (18 items): A SEA TALE, THE ISLAND, A DOME?, TOK! TOK!, CRACK!, AN EGG!, THE ROC, A ROCK!, UH OH!, FASTER!, SPLASH!, MISSED!, BLACK!, STILL BLACK!, HOLLOW!, PROOF!, A LEGEND, THE END (default: as listed).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; cue every action with the literal word times in this plan (they are the timeline.md starts). Set LIFE.t = t each frame for auto-blinks; give explicit lids only where the plan says (held shock uses noBlink).

People are Library person figures with costume presets (see cast). Scales: room s 1.0; island s 0.55; deck s 0.5 on a dhow at s 1.6 (deck y 748, hull 640 wide); thought-cloud figures at least 110 px on screen.

The Roc is bird({kind:'hawk', pal: 1, fly: true, s: 3.4..5.5, flap, grip, carry: (c) => boulder(c, {...}), swing: swing(t, tGrab, 0.4)}). After the release at 96.98 set carry off and draw the boulder in the scene with fallY; between 102.34 and 104.16 slow the fall with a keyed time curve on the rock y only (the ship and crew keep normal time).
Ships and people never slide: the dhow x and the sea scroll come from one distance function; walkers use walk(xf, t) and footfalls; the camel uses walk with GAIT.camel and rideOn.
S4 cross-section follows the Fox drawInside pattern: inside view with the three heads at 1.7x in the opening; S5 entries use the evenodd clip at the hole edge so bodies vanish inside the shell.
Shadow beats (61.06, 71.5, 96.16) are navy alpha 0.35 overlays drawn after the cast and before lettering; keep them inside the picture panel clip.
Panel-only shake for the axe hits (3 units) and the splash (6 units, 0.6 s decay); the caption panel never moves.

Sound: 7 effects only, all in real gaps: whoosh 9.1, chime 21.9, pop 48.1, thud 87.7, whoosh 94.6, pop 149.45, chime 172.9, via SND master 0.6. The axe hits, the crack and the splash fall inside words, so they are lettering only.
The LATER card runs about 63.6 to 65.0 with its covered midpoint at 64.3; put the set change (island to open sea) and a camera key pair 0.01 s apart at that midpoint.
Film length 172.77 + 4.0 = 176.77 s. THE END pops at 172.6 and holds to 176.77 with idle life under it.
Draw order in the room: palaceHall back, feather in the alcove, curtain (keyed), cushions, cast, cloud, lettering, finish last.
warnings: The narration has only six gaps; the climax (rock, splash) has no pause, so it must work silently through staging, lettering and the panel shake.

The person figure is front-facing only: the low-angle shot at 74.8 uses front-facing heads looking up along the bottom edge, not backs of heads; rowing and carrying are shown with body tip and hand targets.
Crew of six on a deck 640 wide: keep 85 to 100 units between figures and never move them in unison; drop sailorB from a shot if it crowds.
Check that pal.beard overrides the age-driven beard colour before building the beard wipe; otherwise add a beard colour field in the story code (not in the Library default).
Room coordinates (curtain, window, ceiling) are read from the catalogue image: approximate, measure on the set anchors. The feather (760 long) may need curl or s 0.9 to fit under the ceiling.
Four medium new drawings (islandShore, openSea, dhow, plus the small rocEgg and giantFeather): share the wave drawing between the two sea sets and build the dhow once for AN-146 as well.
